title: Communication cost of the equality hashing protocol
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the public-coin equality hashing protocol on $n$-bit Boolean inputs with hash range $\mathrm{Fin}(2^k)$ — in which, given a shared random hash $h$, Alice sends the value $h(x) \in \mathrm{Fin}(2^k)$ and Bob replies with the truth value of whether $h(y) = h(x)$ — has worst-case communication complexity exactly $k + 1$ bits.
replaced:
The worst-case communication cost of $\mathrm{equalityHashProtocol}(n, k)$ is
exactly $k + 1$ bits.
